address.explanation: The layer view and the query view answer different questions.  accepted=any_layer_accepted is preserved, so an accepted fact group needs only one accepted layer; accepted_correct=all_layers_accepted_and_correct is preserved, so a strict group needs every layer accepted and correct.  All 62 accepted address layers are correct and 0 accepted layers are wrong, so the 54 partial groups are not wrong-address retrievals at layer level; with two layers they are groups with exactly one accepted correct layer and one abstaining layer.  The historical query accepted_wrong value is preserved and is an aggregation label, not a wrong-address label.  Address acceptance is still unrepaired: 198/256 fact groups never accept a layer and strict coverage is 4/256.
address.headline: 62/62 accepted address layer readouts are correct (0 wrong-address layers) but only 4/256 fact query groups are strict; 54 groups are partial and 198 groups accept no layer.

why_this_bottleneck: Address layer precision is 62/62 with 0 wrong accepted address layers, so accepted address layers are not mis-addressed; the address gap is low strict coverage and partial layer agreement, not a wrong-address mechanism.
Value layer precision is only 57/156 and 99 accepted fact value layers are wrong, so the value readout itself is the dominant accepted error.
Unknown false recall is 10/32 and revoked false recall is 3/16, so abstention is also failing.

The oracle has 252/252 correct accepted fact value layers but still only 102/256 strict groups with 48 partial groups, which isolates layer abstention/aggregation as a remaining limit independent of wrong fact values.
No calibration point repairs the value gates; threshold movement cannot create a correct value readout or a working abstention rule.

evidence.statement: The expert owns exactly gate, up and down parameters and has no bias.
Gradients are taken with respect to tuple(expert.parameters()) only.
Only the selected expert receives gradients; inactive experts are required to have no gradient.
Response cross-entropy gradients are taken with respect to the selected expert's parameters through the frozen decoder path.
A frozen view is readonly and must not carry an autograd graph.
The personality identity is versioned conditioning and is never rewritten by learning.

metric_semantics.layer_view: one row per readout layer; layers are not independent samples and are never treated as extra queries
metric_semantics.partial_group: accepted but not all layers accepted and correct, with no accepted wrong layer; for the two-layer receipts this means exactly one accepted correct layer and one abstention
metric_semantics.query_view: one row per fact query group; acceptance is any-layer and correctness is all-layer

multi_layer_aggregation.note: The strict query view is not the sum of layer views.  Address 62/62 is a layer precision over accepted layers; 4/256 is a strict group count over fact query groups.
